description: See which agent threads failed, need you or are still running, grouped under your bb sections. Child threads nest under their parent across projects, and a collapsed parent still shows its most urgent child. A status-lanes view lists every awake thread under Failed, Needs you, Running, Unread or Idle. Drag threads to reorder, nest or move them between sections, and snooze a quiet family until tomorrow morning. Hover a row for the thread's model, context use, branch, uncommitted changes and pull request. Choose Switchboard under Settings → Appearance → Sidebar in each bb client.
